name: Spike sphere
summary: An urchin: a turning sphere of spikes, each reaching out with its own slice of the spectrum, coloured by how far it reaches.
credit: After the sphere in Sonia Boller's audible-visuals (https://github.com/soniaboller/audible-visuals, Apache License 2.0). The idea only; no code ported.
hint: Each spike follows one slice of the spectrum: Scattered gives every spike a slice at random (a fuzzy urchin); By latitude puts the lows at the poles and the highs round the equator. Colour runs along the palette by reach (the scene's palette gives the original's yellow, red and pink).

params.label: Reach
params.help: How far a full spike reaches out, in radii.

params.label: Hide below
params.help: Spikes reaching less than this (a share of a full one) are not drawn.
